en.headline: Choi rejects push for year-long university internships amid AI shifts
en.dek: Education secretary tells LegCo that reforming four-year degrees into three years of study plus one of full-time internships would risk turning higher education into vocational training.
body: Education Secretary Christine Choi has rejected a suggestion to reform university bachelor's programmes into a three-years-of-study plus one-year-full-time-internship model to address changes in the labour market driven by artificial intelligence.

In a response at the Legislative Council on Wednesday, Choi said university education should not be planned solely according to market demand or manpower shortage data, as labour market needs are diverse and hard to predict. Doing so could create new mismatches and turn higher education into vocational training, contrary to its original value.

She noted that many professional programmes in medicine, education and engineering already include internship requirements, and the government would continue to support institutions in arranging placements flexibly according to subject characteristics. Forcing a full year of internship on all disciplines would compress time for theoretical foundations in the humanities and pure sciences.

zh.headline: 蔡若蓮反對大學改「三加一」強制一年實習
zh.dek: 教育局局長在立法會表示，將四年制改為三年課堂加一年全職實習，有違大學價值，易令高等教育淪為職業訓練。
body: 教育局局長蔡若蓮反對將大學學士課程改為「三年課堂學習、一年全職實習」模式，以適應人工智能對勞工市場帶來的變化。
她周三在立法會回應時表示，大學教育不能單憑市場需要或人力短缺數據規劃課程，因為勞工市場需求多元且難以預測。若因應數據改革，反而會造成新一輪同質化錯配，甚至令高等教育淪為職業訓練，違背原本價值。
她指出，現時不少醫療、教育及工程等專業課程已有實習要求，當局會繼續支持院校按學科特性靈活安排。強制所有學科進行一年全職實習，會壓縮人文及純科學等著重理論基礎的學習時間，削弱院校設計課程的空間。
